description: This file contains unit tests for the IPC (Inter-Process Communication) system in the Rialto project, using Google Test framework. It tests various request and event handling scenarios between a client and server stub, including single and multiple variable requests, responses, event reception, timeout handling, and no-reply requests.

classes.name: RialtoIpcTest
classes.description: A Google Test fixture class for setting up and tearing down IPC tests, including mock objects and client/server stubs.

methods.name: SetUp
methods.description: Initializes mock objects, server and client stubs, and connects the client.

methods.name: TearDown
methods.description: Disconnects and resets the client and server stubs, and resets mock objects.
